args.sql:
SELECT AVG(patsim)
FROM (
    SELECT t.tradereg, ab.patsim
    FROM trader t
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    JOIN advancedbehavior ab ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
    WHERE (
        (tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' = 'Confirmed')
        OR
        CAST(tr.risk_indicators->>'spoofprob' AS DECIMAL) > 0.75
    )
) AS risky_traders;
